method: Candidates are public entities sharing the non-public entity root table. A candidate is accepted only when its query ranges are identical (a differing range means a different subset of the same table, e.g. Module=Vend vs Module=Cust) and the bidirectional field overlap (Jaccard) is at least 0.90. Reviewed by hand; set status to confirmed or rejected. This file is hand-maintainable -- New-ODataTemplates.ps1 reads only entries with status confirmed.
coverage: 568 non-OData entities across the shipped templates were tested; 515 have no public entity on their table at all, 53 had a same-table candidate, 5 passed the range and field tests.
